Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-23 -- isolated first reading (unverified image reading)

Exposure statement: no proposed identification or earlier reading was visible in my context. I opened only PROMPT.md and the packet images (plus crops in rscratch/packet-23 if any). I listed the image files and read their pixel dimensions with sips to tell overviews from tiles; nothing else beyond the rules.

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overviews image-001, image-022, image-035)

Three overviews:
- image-001 (1800x1201): one face of an opened bifolium, landscape, two pages side by side with a central fold (stained). Left page: mostly blank of main text, but with faint show-through/offset lines; at top left a short list of ~7 short lines in a cursive hand (names?, e.g. line starting "Ambrosi..."?), and a large later inscription "QXIII..." written mirrored/upside-down at mid left (shelfmark-like, reads "Q XIII n 1" reversed) and a grey redaction box above it. Pencil number near fold foot ("417"?). Right page: one column of German-looking cursive chancery text, about 30 lines, top line begins near y=150, text ending around y=890; lower third blank. Flourished ascender loops in the top margin. Modern pencil foliation lower right "Stams, StA, Frg. 190r" (archive label, not read further).
- image-022 (1800x1201): the other face, two pages side by side, each with one column of ~27-29 lines of the same cursive chancery hand in German. Large calligraphic loops in the top margin of both pages. Left page text ends near y=880; right page ends near y=870 with a closing formula. Pencil label lower right "Stams, StA, Frg. 190v".
- image-035 (1201x1800): the same face as image-022, rotated 90 degrees (portrait). It also shows, across the fold, a band of faint inverted text (two or three lines in a different, smaller hand) running along the gutter - this band is what the small tiles image-036/037 (1182x626) appear to cover.

Script: German-language documentary cursive (Kurrent/chancery bastarda), single column, no rubrics; enlarged flourished initials at the start of some sentences (e.g. "Er", "Das", "Des"); long horizontal pen strokes used as line-fillers / section separators. Content observably a legal-procedural record (words like procurator, Lehenrichter, Lehensgenossen, Recht, Urteil-type vocabulary). No interlinear glosses seen in the overview.

Tile mapping (inferred from sizes): image-002..021 = 5 columns x 4 rows over face image-001 (rows: 002-006, 007-011, 012-016, 017-021). image-023..034 = 3 columns x 4 rows over face image-022 (rows: 023-025, 026-028, 029-031, 032-034). image-036/037 = two tiles of the gutter band of image-035.

Plan: read face image-022 tiles first (clearest), then the right page of image-001 (tiles in columns 4-5), then the gutter band.

TRANSCRIPTION
(line numbers count from the top of each tile image; lines cut at tile edges noted; overlaps between neighbouring tiles noted rather than repeated as new text)

=== FACE image-022 (Frg. 190v label), LEFT PAGE ===

--- image-023 (top-left tile: left margin and first words of lines 1-11; repaired margin with paper strip) ---
image-023 l.1  gangen [cut]   (preceded by a faint mark in margin)
image-023 l.2  als Lehen[cut]
image-023 l.3  Darauf Ich [cut]   (enlarged flourished D)
image-023 l.4  auf sollich [cut]
image-023 l.5  Lehenrich[cut]
image-023 l.6  willkurlich[cut]
image-023 l.7  verbesprech[cut]  (= verbesprechen? first stroke a long lead-in)
image-023 l.8  Hab do zum[cut]
image-023 l.9  vor dem [cut]
image-023 l.10 (only tops visible) [cut]
Flourished loop of a top-margin cadel visible at top right.

--- image-024 (top row, middle: left page lines 1-9, left part of each line; two large cadel loops in top margin). Overlaps image-023 at the line starts. Note: tiles are much higher-resolution than I assumed; this tile covers only ~the first 40-45% of each left-page line, so image-025 should complete the line ends. ---
image-024 l.1  [ge]gangen welle  Er procurator von Jme ʒitter[cut]   (first letter of the name has a descender: z (ʒ)? or g? -> "zitter-/gitter-"; the overview suggests the full name ends "-houer")
image-024 l.2  als Lehenrichter vnnd Lehennsmannen ain[cut]
image-024 l.3  [Dar]auf Ich als Lehenrichter dem ʒitterhouer z[cut]
image-024 l.4  [a]uf sollich mein zuesprechen, ist ʒitterhouer h[cut]
image-024 l.5  [Le]henrichter vnnd Lehennsgenossen gestannden [cut]
image-024 l.6  [w]illkurlichen geantwurt.  Er gester? dem Pro[cut]   ("gester" uncertain: g-e-s-t-e-r, possibly "gestee"/"gestet")
image-024 l.7  verbesprochnen Aid. vor dem Richter zu Nauders g[cut]
image-024 l.8  Hab dozumals sollichs aufgeben, vnnd welle also h[cut]
image-024 l.9  vor dem Lehenrechten auch thun, auch frey wil[cut]
image-024 l.10 (tops only, cut)
Punctuation: virgule-like comma and medial point; "vnnd" with double n throughout; "zue" for zu once.

--- image-025 (top row, right: line ends of left page lines 1-9, then the gutter). The 3-column grid 023-025 therefore spans only the LEFT page of image-022; the right page of image-022 seems not to be tiled (only visible in overviews 022/035). ---
image-025 l.1  [Jm]e ʒitterhouer. also vor ʒir
image-025 l.2  [Lehennsman]nen ain wissen haben,
image-025 l.3  [ʒitter]houer zugesprochen. vnd
image-025 l.4  [ʒitte]rhouer herfur. vor ʒir als
image-025 l.5  [ge]stannden. vnnd Frey-   (long lead-in stroke on F; line-end hyphen as double stroke)
image-025 l.6  dem Procuratorn seiner
image-025 l.7  Nauders gethon. wol. vnd
image-025 l.8  [w]elle also hie dermassen.
image-025 l.9  [auc]h frey willkurlichen heimit?   (last word uncertain: h-e-i/ie-m-i-t; "hiemit"?)
Letter note: the initial of "ʒir" and of the surname "ʒitterhouer" is the same form (looped, with descender). In context "vor ʒir als Lehenrichter" it is very probably an m-form, i.e. "mir" and "Mitterhouer"; I keep ʒ in the transcription and flag (m?) as a tentative expansion.

Combined left page lines 1-9 (023+024+025):
L1  gangen welle  Er procurator von Jme ʒitterhouer. also vor ʒir (mir?)
L2  als Lehenrichter vnnd Lehennsmannen ain wissen haben,
L3  Darauf Ich als Lehenrichter dem ʒitterhouer zugesprochen. vnd
L4  auf sollich mein zuesprechen, ist ʒitterhouer herfur. vor ʒir (mir?) als
L5  Lehenrichter vnnd Lehennsgenossen gestannden. vnnd Frey-
L6  willkurlichen geantwurt.  Er gester? dem Procuratorn seiner
L7  verbesprochnen Aid. vor dem Richter zu Nauders gethon. wol. vnd
L8  Hab dozumals sollichs aufgeben, vnnd welle also hie dermassen.
L9  vor dem Lehenrechten auch thun, auch frey willkurlichen heimit?

--- image-026 (second row, left: line starts of left page L7-L23; overlaps image-023 at L7-L9) ---
image-026 l.1  verbesproch[cut]   (= L7, overlap)
image-026 l.2  Hab dozum[cut]     (= L8, overlap)
image-026 l.3  vor dem L[cut]     (= L9, overlap)
image-026 l.4  Innhallt d[cut]    (L10)
image-026 l.5  Jme procura[cut]   (L11)
image-026 l.6  Lehennsge[cut]     (L12; long lead-in on L)
image-026 l.7  dozumals [cut]     (L13)
image-026 l.8  Lanndsord[cut]     (L14; long lead-in on L)
image-026 l.9  dise des ʒi[cut]   (L15)
image-026 l.10 procurator[cut]    (L16)
image-026 l.11 frey offen[cut]    (L17)
image-026 l.12 des Stuck[cut]     (L18; "Stuck" with looped S)
image-026 l.13 gerechtigk[cut]    (L19)
image-026 l.14 sy. oder ni[cut]   (L20)
image-026 l.15 vnnd beuo[cut]     (L21)
image-026 l.16 vechsung? [cut]    (L22; uncertain)
image-026 l.17 (tops only) vnnd [cut]  (L23)

--- image-027 (second row, middle: left page L7-L22, first ~45% of each line; L7-L9 overlap image-024) ---
image-027 l.1  verbesprochnen Aid. vor dem Richter zu Nauders g[cut]   (= L7 overlap)
image-027 l.2  Hab dozumals sollichs aufgeben, vnnd welle also h[cut]  (= L8 overlap)
image-027 l.3  vor dem Lehenrechten auch thun, auch frey wil[cut]       (= L9 overlap)
image-027 l.4  Innhallt des procuratorn begern. aufgeben haben. v[cut]   (L10; final word starts with long-stroke v)
image-027 l.5  Jme procuratorn. vor ʒir als Lehenrichter. vn[cut]        (L11)
image-027 l.6  Lehennsgenossen. verpunden alle briefliche gerech[cut]    (L12)
image-027 l.7  dozumals gehabt. vberanntwurt. vnnd sich damit [cut]      (L13)

image-027 l.10 procurator weiter verstannden. dermassen. ob sein [cut]   (L16)
image-027 l.11 frey offennliche. vnnd willkurliche aufsagung se[cut]     (L17)
image-027 l.12 des Stucks Erbrechts. vnnd vberanntwurtung [cut]          (L18; "Erbrechts" with long lead-in stroke through E)
image-027 l.13 gerechtigkaiten. vber bemellt? Stucks lauttennd [cut]     (L19; "bemellt" uncertain, b-e-n/m-e-l-l-t)
image-027 l.14 sy. oder nit das well  Er also zu rechtlicher erk[cut]     (L20)
image-027 l.15 vnnd beuolhen haben.  Auf sollich sein des Proc[cut]      (L21)

image-027 l.17 (tops only, cut)

--- image-028 (second row, right: line ends L7-L22 of left page, then gutter with stain) ---
image-028 l.1  [Na]uders gethon. wol. vnd            (= L7 overlap with 025)
